proposed_category.label: Steps & Stair Streets
proposed_category.note: Every candidate uses c:'steps'; the category is registered in the live branch and all 60 rows were accepted as drafts.

baseline.dedupe_scope: all existing spots globally; candidate names and every alias normalised for case, accents and punctuation, plus nearest-neighbour distance

inclusion_contract.place_type: named outdoor public stairway, monumental staircase, fitness stair, or stair street where the climb itself is the experience
inclusion_contract.physical_or_significance_gate: approximately 40+ steps or 10m+ ascent, OR documented architectural/social significance
inclusion_contract.evidence_gate: at least one official municipal, destination, heritage or access source plus another relevant source and an exact coordinate basis
inclusion_contract.confidence_gate: identity, coordinates, facts, access, novelty and overall must all be high

registry_gaps.note: All 23 formerly missing city slugs are now registered in Ci; the steps category and every candidate city validate in the live model.
